Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatTabIcon: Requires Debug mode ON. Records each tab asset path, texture resolution, native size and final slot size only when the rail geometry changes.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatExactWi: Requires Debug mode ON. Traces drag start, exact amount and rows, inventory drop target, request acceptance and editor context-menu layering.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatOptions: Requires Debug mode ON. Records Terminal and Member row counts and their final block/table rectangles after build, refresh and resize.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalPerformanc: Selects how quickly bulk deposits, withdrawals and Auto-Sort advance in real single-player or a host with one human player. Safe keeps the established limits: 10 objects every 400 ms and 2 Auto-Sort moves followed by 1000 ms. Fast uses 25 objects every 75 ms and 5 moves followed by 150 ms. Custom uses the six options below and can feel nearly instant on a powerful PC with maximum batches and 0 ms waits. It still yields at the CPU budget, keeps one operation in flight and never processes an unlimited inventory in one tick. Dedicated servers, remote multiplayer and split-screen always force Safe.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalBatchUnits: Used only by Custom. Maximum physical objects the authoritative process may validate and move in one deposit or withdrawal micro-batch (1-100). Example: 25 objects means a 100-object deposit needs at least 4 confirmed batches. Higher values finish sooner but make each simulation step heavier.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalBatchDelay: Used only by Custom. Real-time pause after one deposit or withdrawal batch is confirmed before sending the next (0-1000 ms). Example: 100 ms allows about 10 batches per second; 0 removes the deliberate pause but still processes only one confirmed request at a time. Lower values increase responsiveness and network activity.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalAutoSortMo: Used only by Custom. Maximum objects Auto-Sort may move between containers during one bounded step (1-20). Example: 5 allows up to five validated remove/add pairs before yielding. Higher values sort faster but may create a more noticeable frame or simulation spike.
>> Custom: delay after a move step (ms)

Used only by Custom. Real-time pause after an Auto-Sort step that actually moved objects (0-2000 ms). Example: 150 ms spaces replicated inventory changes while still sorting quickly. 0 continues on the next available scheduler turn; it never runs the whole network in one tick.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalInspectedP: Used only by Custom. Maximum objects whose category, rules, affinity and destination may be examined in one Auto-Sort step (10-500). Inspection does not mean movement: 100 inspected objects may produce no moves when everything is already correctly stored. Higher values scan large networks faster but spend more CPU per step.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LocalCpuBudgetM: Used only by Custom. Maximum real CPU time Auto-Sort may spend in one scheduler step before yielding (1-15 ms), even if the inspection or movement limit was not reached. Example: 5 ms favors smooth play; 15 ms can finish sooner on a fast PC but may be perceptible. This is a safety ceiling, never an unlimited mode.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugSkipTermin: When ON, the network UI can be opened from anywhere, without needing a physical GS terminal nearby or being within tablet wireless range. Useful for testing or creative play. OFF by default: requires a terminal or tablet, like in a normal game.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalProximi: How close a player must stand to a GS terminal to open the network without a tablet (in tiles).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalNetwork: Maximum horizontal distance from a network's primary terminal within which an additional terminal counts as part of that coverage and can be linked to it on install.
Maximum floor difference from the primary terminal for an additional terminal to count as within coverage. 0 = unlimited (any floor or basement counts as long as it's within the horizontal range).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AccessHysteresi: Extra tiles of tolerance before the UI closes when moving away from the terminal. 0 = strict close the moment the player leaves range. Higher values prevent flickering when the character hovers near the edge.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequirePower_to: The network only operates when there's power near the controller terminal (normal grid or generator; also checks a radius around it, not just the exact tile). Turn OFF to keep the network always active regardless of electricity.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableFuelConsu: EXPERIMENTAL, still being tested. OFF by default out of caution: the network consumes nothing, it just requires power to be present (see 'Require electricity' above, that one is stable). If turned ON, while the network is running off a nearby active generator (never off the normal grid, before the blackout), fuel is slowly drained according to 'Base consumption' and 'Per-container consumption'.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_FuelConsumption: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental). Fuel the network drains per in-game hour just for being active, before adding per-container consumption. Same unit the generator itself uses (like the vanilla 'Generator fuel consumption' option).
Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental). Extra fuel the network drains per in-game hour, multiplied by the number of containers/nodes it has registered. Bigger networks consume more.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableGenerator: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental, still being tested). Instead of only using the nearest generator, looks for all generators/batteries inside the same building as the terminal and splits consumption across all of them.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_EnableBatteryCo: Requires 'Consume generator fuel' ON (experimental, still being tested). Tries to also include batteries from solar mods (Immersive Solar Arrays, Plysken Solar Revolution) in the consumption split, alongside regular generators. Since this relies on those mods' internal data, it's not guaranteed to keep working if they change their internal format; if it stops detecting them, the network simply won't drain that source, no errors.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxTerminalsPer: How many physical GS terminal furniture pieces can be linked to a single network. Raise for large bases; lower for challenge servers.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxZonesPerNetw: How many named storage zones a single network can have (e.g. 'Kitchen', 'Garage'). The default of 8 is sufficient for most bases.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxNodesPerNetw: Total container limit across all zones in one network. Very high values may impact server performance during scans.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_MaxContainersPe: Container limit when scanning a single zone. Acts as a performance safety cap for very large zone areas; does not limit the overall network total.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugSkipContai: When ON, the global fallback stops requiring zone-scan containers to be within range of the nearest active terminal. A network can still override this setting. It does not change terminal-to-network link distance. OFF by default: enforces the global container-range fallback.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalContain: Maximum tile distance from the nearest active terminal within which a container is included by a zone scan. 40 tiles covers most single houses.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AllowMarkedCont: Allows connecting vanilla boxes, wardrobes and fridges to the network. Turn OFF to restrict the network to dedicated GS storage cells only (future feature).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AllowSafehouseI: Allows creating a storage zone that automatically covers a player's claimed safehouse area. Useful for quick base setup in multiplayer.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RescanOnTermina: Updates all zone containers every time a player opens the terminal. Recommended ON. Turn OFF only if containers rarely change and you want to reduce server load.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_NetworkInactivi: Days without connecting before an admin/member stops blocking ownership recovery of a network whose owner died, even if their character never died. Does not remove their membership.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_OwnerInactivity: Days an owner can go without connecting before a currently active admin of that network is allowed to claim ownership themselves, without waiting for the owner to die or the network to become formally vacant.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_ReaderAcquireCr: How long (same time units as crafting recipes) the 'Build a reader' window takes to assemble the GS Floppy Drive from its 3 parts.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_PCAcquireCraftT: How long the 'Get a PC' window takes to assemble a desktop computer from its 4 parts.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_TerminalInstall: How long installing a network disk on a computer takes (reader + disk method). Shared by the core mod and any addon that installs its own disk on a terminal.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AddonInstallSki: Minimum Electronics skill level required to install or uninstall any terminal addon (floppy drive, 3D printer, WiFi antenna, digital whiteboard).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugMode_toolt: WARNING: Any enabled debug logging can reduce game and server performance; DETAIL logs may generate massive output. Use only for targeted diagnostics, enable only the required >> blocks, and disable during normal play and on production servers.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugRelayToCli: Off by default. Sends enabled diagnostics in bounded batches only to subscribed administrators. The server checks access on subscription and on every delivery; access loss or disconnect removes the subscription.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatNetwork: Requires Debug mode. Summarizes client/server commands, sequence and synchronization state. Full payloads remain in the separate >>> DETAIL block.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatTermina: Requires Debug mode ON. Every proximity/access check against a terminal (manifest, registry, range evaluation). Fires repeatedly while trying to open a terminal - very verbose.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatPermiss: Requires Debug mode. Bounded traces for character UUID lifecycle, faction/online roster merging, idempotent member changes and identity invariants. Names are diagnostic only and never authorize access.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatCraft_t: Requires Debug mode ON. Retroactive recipe grants from manuals already read, and free-crafting overrides. Low volume - useful when a recipe won't show up in the crafting menu.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatInvento: Requires Debug mode ON. Deposits, bulk redistribution jobs, and item category/subcategory tagging.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatTooltip: Requires Debug mode ON. The "how much do I have in my network" tooltip patch on vanilla item tooltips (render failures, fallback path used).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatRouter_: Requires Debug mode. Summarizes destination selection for deposits and Auto Sort. Per-node decisions remain in the separate >>> DETAIL block.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatRuleMig: Requires Debug mode. Records the recoverable server-side migration of obsolete one-letter category dimensions, including bounded source samples and the idempotent second pass.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatCapacit: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs the personal capacity bonus detected per container for the requesting player (e.g. the Organized trait), read live from the vanilla getEffectiveCapacity(character) API - the same one the game already uses to decide if a deposit fits.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatZones_t: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs every zone creation attempt (name, source, network, bounds), whether it exactly matches an already-registered zone, and the current zone count against the sandbox limit.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatLiterat: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs the client learned-recipe cache/probe and every Storage literature-read route: instance title, magazine pages, network state and client name. It supports verifying the already-read checkmark against real data.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatItemAct: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs every time the inventory right-click context menu fires and whether the Storage window is visible at that moment, to diagnose why the Transfer option is not showing up.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatAddons_: Requires Debug mode ON. Logs the addon catalog, ID and ModID, registration attempt, availability, cause and surface mount; also the exact item consumed or returned during install or removal.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RemoteTransferE: Allows inserting and withdrawing items from the network via the terminal UI without physically walking to the container. Turn OFF for a more realistic experience.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_AutoSortEnabled: Automatically routes deposited items to the most appropriate container based on category rules and zone configuration. Turn OFF to always deposit into the first available container.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_BulkDepositEnab: Enables the ‘Store all’ button, which attempts to deposit eligible items from the player inventory in one action. Items skipped by safeguards or that cannot be deposited remain in their source container.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RejectDepositIf: Reject deposit if no matching container

If an item has no matching category/filter, exact-item affinity, or canonical taxonomy affinity, keep it in its source container instead of placing it in the first available ‘Any’ container. OFF by default (generic containers remain available, as before).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RespectFavorite: Items marked as favourite in the inventory are skipped by 'Store all'. Recommended ON to protect important items from being accidentally deposited.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RespectEquipped: When enabled, ‘Store all’ skips worn clothing, held weapons, and carried bags. Recommended ON.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequireRecipeBo: Players must read GS manual magazines before seeing and crafting each GS item, mirroring how vanilla skill books work. Turn OFF to unlock all GS recipes immediately.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_RequireWorkbenc: GS recipes can only be crafted at a work surface (table, counter, etc.). Turn OFF to allow hand-crafting anywhere without a surface.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootBooksWeight: Relative spawn chance for GS manual magazines in bookshelves, libraries and electronics stores. Set to 0 to disable GS manuals from appearing in loot entirely. Higher values increase frequency.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootFloppyDiskW: Relative spawn chance for the GS Network Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (you'll only be able to program one instead - or rely on someone else's find).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootBlankDiskWe: Relative spawn chance for the GS Blank Disk, the raw material every programmable disk is made from. 0 disables it from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootUninstallDi: Relative spawn chance for a pre-made GS Uninstall Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still programmable from a blank disk).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootDriveDiskWe: Relative spawn chance for a pre-made GS Drive Disk. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still programmable from a blank disk).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootManualWeigh: Relative spawn chance for the GS Network Monthly and Home Computing Digest build manuals. 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootDiskProgram: Relative spawn chance for the disk-programming magazines (network, uninstall and drive disks). 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootSolderingIr: Relative spawn chance for the GS Soldering Iron, required to craft any GS part. 0 disables it from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootPCPartsWeig: Relative spawn chance for the individual PC and terminal reader components (tower, motherboard, casing, etc.). 0 disables them from loot entirely.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootTerminalRea: Relative spawn chance for a fully assembled GS Floppy Drive found ready-made. 0 disables it from loot entirely (still fully craftable).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_LootSolderingIr: Loot weight: DIY soldering iron guide
Relative spawn chance for the magazine that teaches the Soldering Iron recipe. 0 disables it from loot entirely. Useless unless 'Allow crafting the Soldering Iron' below is also ON.

Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatSiKUI_t: Requires Debug mode. Records Global Storage integration and framework events routed to its logger (mounting, geometry and interaction). The framework retains its independent diagnostics switch.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatRecorde: Requires Debug mode ON. Summarizes each changed tape projection: rows, exact/unresolved titles, L3 With learning/Leisure and up to five sample indexes. It never dumps item objects or logs per frame.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatSiKUITa: Requires Debug mode ON. Traces the side tab rail and the Core/add-on tab-registration contract: panel creation/reuse, visibility toggles, and tab click activation/cancellation.
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatSiKUISe: Requires Debug mode ON. Traces every change in the Items tab search box: UTF-16 unit length vs real Unicode character length, and the received text. Meant for diagnosing search in non-ASCII languages (Chinese, Japanese, Korean...).
Sandbox_GlobalStorageSiK_DebugCatNodeNam: Requires Debug mode ON. Applying a container's display name to its in-world object (menu/inventory name). Separate from the "SiK UI:" entries above - this is naming logic, not the UI framework itself.
